criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Every frame a physical render on a dark field, encodings measure correctly, machine_qa clean. Subjects rarely lit as forms. 1 best but beam, horsehead and post pure black. 3 flat-shaded primitives and untextured wellhead, hard to name at feed size. 7 white rings read as coins, labels float, a blob behind. 2 a shadow wedge with no visible caster, no curl, clip a black rectangle. 4 sine corrugation, counterweight clips white. 5 square rods, flat tag, empty top tread. 6 mid-tone tanks with dot weathering. 9 most complete, ids over the legs. Between 4 and 7, closer to 7.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One type system, one dusk, dark fields, accent on figure frames, the camera move works. Crank motif and sky hue fail; reliefs disagree on light; 6's olive wall sits slightly outside.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces. Looser: the pump-jack image asserts rod lift where c1 says only artificial lift; the regulator line rests on the Tribune; the first comment printed a raw source-type token.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: Who, what and a next date are present. Where stops at a leasehold share though c17 names Reeves County. The stake stays abstract and nothing ties the meeting to this item.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Cover and 2 work; turns at 3 and 8. 6 cuttable, 5 half cuttable. The close asks the right question.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean and on register with specific vocabulary. Frame copy is mostly flat recitation; 8's hook truncates.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: Topic new to the window. lastLight again; the lone machine at last light opener and the closed ranch gate echo no. 62.

one_sentence_fix: Light the subjects rather than the sky, with a low raking work light in the chassis rig and real material response on the kit models.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: White rings read as coins; bodies smear; labels float; a blob behind.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Chamfered box ends with recessed bores in worn steel, key raked from the left at about 6 degrees; remove the blob.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Flat-shaded primitives, untextured wellhead, subject unidentifiable, left half empty.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Camera to 0.6 m and in until the rod and stuffing box fill the right two thirds; galvanized tee and valve with cavity grime.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A shadow wedge with no visible caster; no curl; clip a black rectangle.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Raise the far corner so the wedge is visibly cast by the curl; seat the page with a thin contact shadow.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Square rods; flat tag; empty top 40 percent.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Round rod profile with round couplings and flats; move the pair up into the middle band.
Noise bedding on strata_block; lower the counterweight albedo.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Flat mid-tone tank wall; dot weathering reads as mould.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Hard side key so each shell rolls to black; vertical rust streaks from the seams.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Jack near-pure black apart from the crank.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Widen the work light to rake the beam web and horsehead face.
